declaration_order: Before calculating any EXEC36 single-SiPM or grouped timestamp distribution
mapping_convention: Low cluster -> CH1 (inputs 0+2); high cluster -> CH5 (inputs 4+6). V2 assigns two adjacent physical IDs per input, matching GroupIndex. V1 retains the first physical ID of each such input pair; right adds 8. This is an explicit simulation wiring convention, not confirmed hardware mapping. V1 excludes local IDs 1,3,5,7.
sensitivity_shape: Same peak-normalized difference-of-exponentials Pulse and unchanged LeadingEdgeTime function bodies, with only their three constants parameterized. Do not substitute the different dCFD product kernel.

sanity.width: canonical sigma_core of single-SiPM leading edge relative to gun t=0, before any grouping
sanity.intermediate: 100<=width<150 or 350<width<=500: INDETERMINATE, not a pass; no tuning
sanity.invalid: Invalid EXEC35 robust width is INDETERMINATE
sanity.campaign_guard: Any extreme single-SiPM failure in the baseline 21-cell/two-end census makes ALL grouped results NOT COMPARABLE with test beam until discriminator calibration. Otherwise retain each cell/end sanity status; passing this check does not resolve the documented hardware differences.

bootstrap.unit: generated event (10000 IDs), including NaNs before resampling; joint T1/T2 acceptance fixed per event
bootstrap.uncertainty: standard deviation ddof=1; percentile 95% intervals; fixed group mapping and discriminator parameters

validity: Unchanged analysis/sigma_t/validity_exec35.json. New FitCore points and event-bootstrap errors; successful fits required for Gaussian bootstrap replicas.
normalization: Report raw sigma(T1-T2) and sigma/sqrt(2); the latter assumes equal independent group contributions, inherited test-beam assumption, not verified
paired_design: All 21 cells share simulation seeds 26092601 and 8349041; points within material are correlated; no fit sigma(x), BLUE or combined arms
test_beam_reference_source: User EXEC36 attachment; quoted reference values and hardware statements are not newly measured or independently verified in this analysis
